    Chains along words #

    Rel l x y says that y follows x along the letter l: y = a x for a direct letter a, and x = a y for an inverse letter a⁻¹ (with x, resp. y, in the source vertex space of a). A vector lies in L^* U exactly when it starts a chain along L ending in U (mem_trs_iff).

    Prop
